phrase.zh: 一次相遇，改写星系的形状。

visual.zh: 两组旋臂在画中卷向彼此，像慢速相遇留下的潮汐曲线。这不是两座具体星系的观测照片或碰撞模拟结果。
visual.en: Two spiral forms curl toward each other like tidal traces of a slow encounter. This is not a photograph or simulation of named galaxies.

background.zh: 星系相互作用时，引力可扭曲其形状，并压缩气体、触发新的恒星形成。虽然称为“碰撞”，星系中的恒星间距通常很大，单个恒星直接相撞并不常见。
background.en: During a galaxy encounter, gravity can distort shapes and compress gas, triggering star formation. Despite the word “collision,” individual stars are widely separated and direct star-to-star impacts are uncommon.
